0.0: On to the final stage already! My how time flies. This challenge may perhaps be your hardest yet. It was design to test your patience. A good Resistance operative knows that while agility and attack power are important, the most crucial trait of a member of the Resistance is patience.

yes.0: Upon entering #b#m310010300##k, you'll encounter #r#o9300411# units#k. They have high HP. Consequently, they will not be easily dispatched. I don't want to say they're powerful, as that would be untruthful. They are however quite durable. You must exercise patience, and continue your assault until you have eliminated #r5 of them#k.

no.0: Are you really calling it quits? ...Very well. I can't say I'm not disappointed.

1.0: You've already defeated #o9300411# units? Stupendous! I think you may have beaten the previous record. In celebration of your achievement, I've prepared a special challenge.

yes.0: You continue to impress, #h0#! For you, I have prepared a special challenge. Ready to begin?

mob.0: You haven't defeated #r5 #o9300411# units#k yet? That's all right. Patience is a difficult trait to master.
